jobs.prompt: Three medium review findings on the shipped 1.165.0 restart and update code; fix all three. (1) tools/server-restart.mjs isProcessLockStale (about line 413) treats a lock older than 60 seconds as stale even when its owner process is alive; a restart can take longer (15 s stop, 15 s port wait, up to 20 s per start attempt) so a second swarm update could steal a live lock and race: do not expire a lock whose owner pid is alive and whose owner identity matches (same pid and same recorded start time); use the age rule only when the owner pid is unreadable or dead; also have the owner refresh the lock timestamp every 5 seconds while it holds the lock (unref timer, cleared on release); the rename-based steal must not remove a lock that was recreated by someone else in between: re-read and compare owner before removing. (2) tools/server-restart.mjs commandLineMatchesRecord (about lines 137 to 183): a server started through versions/OLD/tools/swarm.mjs or through a different launcher path does not match installRoot/current/tools/swarm.mjs after realpath, so it is reported identity-unverified and never restarted; store the runner path (and its realpath) in the server record at start time (tools/watch-cli.mjs and the remote server registration) and match against that recorded runner path first, then against any install runner path (current or versions/*/tools/swarm.mjs under the same install root) by realpath; also handle install paths with spaces by comparing the argv tokens of the process (read with ps -o args via a safe tokenization that keeps the runner path as one token when the path exists on disk), and keep failing closed when nothing matches. (3) tools/update-pending.mjs lines about 373 and 379 with tools/swarm/core-52.mjs createDescribeUpdateBusy (lines about 541 to 549): describeBusy is called without heldPids so a held autopilot or go loop is still counted busy and --when-idle waits for the loop that waits for it: pass the heldPids set through describeBusy to machineBusySnapshot and to isPidHeldOrAncestor and runIsHeldAutopilot. Tests in tests/server-restart-round4.test.mjs and tests/update-pending-round4.test.mjs: live owner older than 60 seconds keeps its lock and a second acquirer waits; a dead-owner lock is stolen; the steal does not remove a recreated lock; the refresh timer updates the timestamp and is cleared; a server recorded with a versions-folder runner path matches and restarts; a mismatching process stays unverified; a path with spaces matches; a held autopilot pid is not counted busy and the idle wait succeeds. Keep every existing test passing; run all test files with server-restart, update-pending or update-when-idle in the name. Hermetic tests, no ambient environment, no network, no token-shaped literals. ignoreTests reason: only the named files and their tests change.
